title: Detection range
line: The radar range equation from 0.001 to 10 m² of RCS.
description: Detection range against radar cross-section from the radar range equation, for an X-band radar integrating 64 pulses coherently. The signal-to-noise needed for a 90% probability of detection at a 1e-6 false-alarm rate comes from Albersheim's equation.
thumbnailAlt: Detection range of an X-band radar against radar cross-section on log axes, rendered by RunMat
